title: Phase Interview Workspace
executionReleaseCondition: WC06 is accepted and the Operator explicitly releases WC07.
purpose: Implement the Phase Intake interview workspace, phase-specific Architect handoff, repo-backed Phase_Interview review, and disposition without hidden active-phase state.

workspace.label: Phase Interview
workspace.layout: Embedded Architect browser plus Phase_Interview preview and disposition

requiredInputs: Approved Phase_Map and selected phase record
Approved prior phase closeout when applicable
Relevant project risks, constraints, decisions, and repository evidence
requiredInterviewContent: prior phase closeout context when applicable
clarification questions and answers when required
phase-specific constraints, dependencies, risks, and outcome
noQuestionsBehavior: The Architect still writes Phase_Interview and records that required context was reviewed and no additional clarification was necessary.
completionRule: Phase Intake completes only when Phase_Interview is Approved.
prohibitedScope: Phase Planning or Work Card Plan generation
Route tokens, role gates, approval queues, hashes, or execution runs
Provider APIs, DOM automation, or credential extraction
validation: Operator manual validation through the accepted embedded Architect/MCP path
